ShardOutcome.description: The three ways one unit of hosted work ends.
ShardOutcome.title: ShardOutcome

changelog.change: `shard` carries two reserved values below zero.
changelog.why: The two units that run once a date could not file a row at all.

changelog.change: Initial shape: the unit, its clock, its outcome and the hosted cost.
changelog.why: Nothing recorded whether the council's own pipeline worked.

description: One unit of council work: how it ended, what it cost, and who it hosted.

date.description: The digest date this run judged.
date.title: Date

host_model.description: The processor name, one line read from the kernel's own file. Without it a slow night and a slower processor read identically, and there is no join key onto what already characterises the runner pool.
host_model.title: Host Model

judge_id.description: Which tenant this unit hosted. Without it a night running two tenants files rows nobody can attribute. Recorded rather than validated: there is no membership check, because the council records who ran and never declares who may exist. The value arrives from the tenant's own module constant, so a typo is a source edit a reviewer sees.
judge_id.title: Judge Id

model_calls.description: How many calls the hosted work made. Empty, not zero, for a tenant that runs no model - zero would read as a model that answered nothing. One call, one count, derived from no other column.
model_calls.title: Model Calls

model_seconds.description: Wall clock inside model calls. Read against `seconds_spent`, the two say how much of a unit was the model and how much was everything else.
model_seconds.title: Model Seconds

outcome.description: How the unit ended. A unit killed by the platform writes no row at all, and absence against the recorded count is what says so.

run_id.description: The council run, minted from the day the council ran.
run_id.title: Run Id

seconds_spent.description: Wall clock for the unit of work. Not the job: the job's own clock includes a checkout and a weights restore this row is not about, and those are recorded where the job is.
seconds_spent.title: Seconds Spent

shard.description: Which unit of the split this row is about. Two values below zero are reserved for the units that run once a date rather than once a shard: -1 picked the work and -2 counted what came back. Without them a run whose count died would leave no row saying so.
shard.title: Shard

shards.description: How many units the work was split across. A run reporting fewer rows than this left work unread, and the pair alone says so. The two reserved units carry the run's real width, so one date's rows all agree.
shards.title: Shards

tokens_in.description: Prompt tokens the server reported across the unit.
tokens_in.title: Tokens In

tokens_out.description: Generated tokens the server reported across the unit.
tokens_out.title: Tokens Out

title: CouncilShardOutcome
